paper_title: Search for Axion dark matter with the QUAX-LNF tunable haloscope
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, canonical axion-photon coupling as plotted
notes: QUAX-LNF tunable haloscope, TM010 mode cavity at 8.83 GHz, 8T field. Best limit g_agamma < 0.882e-13 GeV^-1 at 90% CL over mass range 36.52413-36.5511 ueV. Limit is approximately flat across the narrow scanned range; emitted as two-point line at the quoted best value. Local DM density 0.45 GeV/cm^3.
